boundary: Family-scoped S4 query and sentinel development for open-index discovery only; not a frozen systematic search, eligibility decision, or PRISMA input.

queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR Copilot) AND ("code review" OR "validating and repairing") AND (developer OR human OR cognitive OR workload OR attention OR time OR effort OR trust)
+("large language model" | LLM | "generative AI") +"code review" +(time | workload | attention | effort | efficiency | quality | verification | trust)

sentinels.title: Developer Behaviors in Validating and Repairing LLM-Generated Code Using IDE and Eye Tracking
sentinels.rationale: OpenAlex-indexed experiment measuring IDE behavior, eye tracking, and cognitive workload during validation and repair of generated code.

sentinels.title: Human and Machine: How Software Engineers Perceive and Engage with AI-Assisted Code Reviews Compared to Their Peers
sentinels.rationale: OpenAlex-indexed practitioner study reporting cognitive, emotional, behavioral, trust, and context effects in LLM-assisted review.

sentinels.title: Automated Code Review In Practice
sentinels.rationale: Mixed industrial evidence: automated comments were frequently resolved and perceived quality improved slightly, while average closure duration increased.

sentinels.title: Same Scrutiny, More Time: Eye Tracking Insights into Reviewing LLM-Labelled Code
sentinels.rationale: Direct behavioral evidence about review time and attention when code is labelled as LLM-generated.

sentinels.title: Automated Code Review In Practice
sentinels.rationale: Industrial evidence linking automated LLM review to acted-on feedback, perceived quality benefits, and longer pull-request closure duration.

sentinels.title: From Human-Centric to Agentic Code Review: The Impact of Different Generations of Generative AI Technology on Review Quality
sentinels.rationale: In-scope evidence of faster decisions in some agent-involved patterns without consistent joint efficiency-and-quality superiority.

sentinels.title: Modern Code Review: A Case Study at Google
sentinels.rationale: Foundational non-LLM code-review evidence; retrieval is a precision warning, while absence is not evidence against the framework.
